hook.line: I just interviewed with Anthropic, so you don't have to; here's the lowdown.
hook.visual: Handheld selfie walking down a London street, blue jacket, white two-line title about the AE role at Anthropic over her chest.

beats.what: Walking selfie, insider claim ('I just interviewed with Anthropic') with a fixed topic title
Verdict up front: they are not hiring account executives
Credibility line: 15 years in sales, then what they are not looking for
Zoom punch on the twist: they want a consultant who sits with boards
Closing line: 'they're not looking for closers', then the video ends

why_it_works: First-hand insider access to a hot company in the first sentence, so the viewer gets information they can't get elsewhere
Conclusion stated by 5 s, then the reasons, so it rewards the short attention span
One unbroken walking shot feels like a candid voice note, which makes the opinion credible
Short (35 s) and ends on a punchy line, which helps replays
weaknesses: No captions for the speech; only a fixed title, so sound-off viewers miss everything
Quiet audio relative to the other videos
No call to action at all
for_robert: Lead with a first-hand 'I just did X so you don't have to' and give the verdict in the first 5 s; avoid shipping with no speech captions.
